page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU capabilities of this instance are generally modest. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% tier. However, the Intel Xeon processor achieves average results in Passmark CPU tests, including the extended instructions and physics simulations. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show a contrast, where small-block cached reads are weak, but large-block uncached read and write operations perform at an average level.

The ecs.se1.2xlarge instance is applicable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage. It achieves average performance in Redis SET operations, processing 5.94 million operations per second, and handles small-model LLM inference at average speeds. Conversely, it exhibits poor performance in single-threaded compression tasks and larger LLM inference models. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a viable option for caching layers, lightweight databases, and memory-bound applications where raw processing speed is secondary.
